Record Class LogOutput.ContentType.DefaultContentType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.ContentType.DefaultContentType
Record Components:
contentType - content type, e.g. text/plain.
charsetOrNull - charset or null if not fixed/known.
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogOutput.ContentType
Enclosing interface:
LogOutput.ContentType
public static record LogOutput.ContentType.DefaultContentType(String contentType, @Nullable Charset charsetOrNull) extends Record implements LogOutput.ContentType
A plain LogOutput.ContentType for content types not covered by LogOutput.ContentType.StandardContentType. Use LogOutput.ContentType.of(String, Charset) to create one (or reuse a matching LogOutput.ContentType.StandardContentType instead if one matches).
